post.title: Only 2 Left? Read This First #shorts
post.description: Lila sees "only two left", buys both, then finds a full tray in the back. Psychologists call it the scarcity effect. In a 1975 study (Worchel, Lee & Adewole), students rated identical chocolate-chip cookies from a jar of 10 or a jar of only 2; the cookies from the near-empty jar were rated more desirable. They were valued even more when the jar went from 10 to 2 because other people wanted them. Next time a sign says only two left, ask: would I still want it if there were ten? #psychology #shorts #marketing #scarcity
